items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Anyway, Harold Iller, he took Luther West's place

ctx.x: No, it started with an I. I believe it's Iller or something like that. Anyway, Harold Iller, he took Luther West's place; have you heard of the Happy Hour? I went into the Happy Hour in Minneapolis--
We played with Nat Towles, just ahead of you.
